layout: transform
name: soundwave, sonic spy
mana cost: {1}{W}{U}{B}
types: legendary artifact creature robot
power toughness: 5/4
alternate cost: more than meets the eye {2}{W}{U}{B}
triggered: whenever one or more creature tokens you control deal combat damage to a player, exile target instant or sorcery card with mana value equal to the damage dealt from their graveyard. copy it. you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. if you do, convert CARDNAME.

ALTERNATE

name: soundwave, superior captain
types: legendary artifact
triggered: whenever you cast a spell with an odd mana value, convert CARDNAME. if you do, create ravage, a legendary 3/3 black robot artifact creature token with menace and deathtouch.
triggered: whenever you cast a spell with an even mana value, convert CARDNAME. if you do, create laserbeak, a legendary 2/2 blue robot artifact creature token with flying and hexproof.
